slides.title: "Is it for time?"
slides.body: It says For Time at the top of the board. In green. Underlined.

slides.title: "Over the bar?"
slides.body: The burpees? Yes. The coach demoed it. Twice. You nodded both times.

slides.title: "Five rounds?"
slides.body: Yes. It has been five since 5:45 this morning.

slides.title: "Can I still scale?"
slides.body: Yes. Same answer as the brief, when we asked who wanted to scale.

slides.title: "Last movement?"
slides.body: It's the second of four. Keep moving.

slides.title: "Was that time?"
slides.body: That was time. Write down whatever you think you did.
